title: Unraveling the binding mechanism of an Oxovanadium(IV) - Curcumin complex on albumin, DNA and DNA gyrase by in vitro and in silico studies and evaluation of its hemocompatibility.
authors: Avgoulas, Dimitrios Iota; Katsipis, Georgios; Halevas, Eleftherios; Geromichalou, Elena G; Geromichalos, George D; Pantazaki, Anastasia A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体外实验和分子对接模拟探究钒-姜黄素配合物与白蛋白、DNA及DNA旋转酶的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA体系但非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法以常规对接为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: An oxovanadium(IV) - curcumin based complex, viz. [VO(cur)(2,2 -bipy)(H(2)O)] where cur is curcumin and bipy is bipyridine, previously synthesized, has been studied for interaction with albumin and DNA. Fluorescence emission spectroscopy was used to evaluate the interaction of the complex with bovine serum albumin (BSA) and the BSA-binding constant (K(b)) was calculated to be 2.56 x 10(5) M(-1), whereas a single great-affinity binding site was revealed. Moreover, the hemocompatibility test demonstrated that the complex presented low hemolytic fraction (mostly below 1%), in all concentrations tested (0-250 muMu of complex, 5% DMSO) assuring a safe application in interaction with blood. The binding of the complex to DNA was also investigated using absorption, fluorescence, and viscometry methods indicating a binding through a minor groove mode. From competitive studies with ethidium bromide the apparent binding constant value to DNA was estimated to be 4.82 x 10(6) M(-1). Stern-Volmer quenching phenomenon gave a Kappa(SV) constant [1.92 (+/- 0.05) x 10(4) M(-1)] and k(q) constant [8.33 (+/- 0.2) x 10(11) M(-1)s(-1)]. Molecular docking simulations on the crystal structure of BSA, calf thymus DNA, and DNA gyrase, as well as pharmacophore analysis for BSA target, were also employed to study in silico the ability of [VO(cur)(2,2 -bipy)(H(2)O)] to bind to these target bio-macromolecules and explain the observed in vitro activity.
abstract_zh: 一种基于氧钒(IV)-姜黄素的配合物，即[VO(cur)(2,2-bipy)(H(2)O)]，其中cur为姜黄素，bipy为联吡啶，该配合物此前已合成，现研究了其与白蛋白和DNA的相互作用。采用荧光发射光谱法评估了该配合物与牛血清白蛋白（BSA）的相互作用，计算得到BSA结合常数（K(b)）为2.56 x 10(5) M(-1)，并揭示了一个高亲和力结合位点。此外，血液相容性测试表明，在所有测试浓度（0-250 muM配合物，5% DMSO）下，该配合物表现出低溶血分数（大多低于1%），确保了其在血液相互作用中的安全应用。还通过吸收光谱法、荧光光谱法和粘度法研究了该配合物与DNA的结合，表明其通过小沟模式结合。通过与溴化乙锭的竞争性研究，估算其对DNA的表观结合常数为4.82 x 10(6) M(-1)。Stern-Volmer猝灭现象给出了Kappa(SV)常数[1.92 (+/- 0.05) x 10(4) M(-1)]和k(q)常数[8.33 (+/- 0.2) x 10(11) M(-1)s(-1)]。还对BSA、小牛胸腺DNA和DNA旋转酶的晶体结构进行了分子对接模拟，并对BSA靶点进行了药效团分析，以在计算机上研究[VO(cur)(2,2-bipy)(H(2)O)]与这些靶标生物大分子结合的能力，并解释观察到的体外活性。
